mappings.note: What the Council's notice meant to the British government (a challenge): content comprehension of the diary entry, LO-1. Not LO-2, which concerns the writer's standpoint and style.
Why the procession broke up at the Dharmatalla turning: comprehension of an event in the text, LO-1.
What happened to the crowd when the procession reached Lal Bazar: content comprehension, LO-1.
Why 26 January 1931 mattered to the people of Calcutta: comprehension of the entry's occasion, LO-1.
Which scene made one shut one's eyes: comprehension of a described moment, LO-1.
What notice the Police Commissioner issued: content comprehension, LO-1.
Who bore responsibility for Subhas Babu's procession: content comprehension, LO-1.
Where Harish Chandra Singh raised the flag: content comprehension, LO-1.
At what hour the police surrounded the Monument: content comprehension of a stated detail, LO-1.
What flew over the houses of Bara Bazar: content comprehension, LO-1.
Which style predominates in this writer's work: भाषा-शैली, LO-2, not the content of the diary entry.

When the diary page was written: the entry carries its own date, so this is comprehension of the text rather than external biography (contrast qid:104266).

Sitaram Seksaria's date of birth: author biography, cited at competency level for the same reason as qid:104265.
Who Avinash Babu was: a figure inside the diary entry, so content comprehension, LO-1.

Where the girls held their flag ceremony: content comprehension, LO-1.
Why the police cordoned off the large parks and maidans: comprehension of an event and its reason, LO-1.
